name: @deeptail/root
description: DeepTail: a Tauri desktop and mobile client that monitors and drives DeepSeek Harness sessions on a remote host.

scripts.a11y: bun run --filter @deeptail/app build && bun test apps/deeptail/tests/a11y.browser.spec.ts apps/deeptail/tests/a11y-errors.browser.spec.ts apps/deeptail/tests/tailnet.browser.spec.ts --timeout 180000 && echo 'axe: no accessibility violations'
scripts.mutate: bun run mutate:host-fleet && bun run mutate:sheets && bun run mutate:gates && bun run mutate:tools && bun run mutate:app
scripts.mutate:app: trap 'bun scripts/mutate-restore.ts' EXIT INT TERM; stryker run stryker.app.json
scripts.mutate:gates: trap 'bun scripts/mutate-restore.ts' EXIT INT TERM; stryker run stryker.gates.json
scripts.mutate:host-fleet: trap 'bun scripts/mutate-restore.ts' EXIT INT TERM; stryker run stryker.host-fleet.json
scripts.mutate:sheets: trap 'bun scripts/mutate-restore.ts' EXIT INT TERM; stryker run stryker.sheets.json
scripts.mutate:tools: trap 'bun scripts/mutate-restore.ts' EXIT INT TERM; stryker run stryker.tools.json
scripts.test:browser: bun run --filter @deeptail/app build && bun test apps/deeptail/tests --timeout 60000
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p packages/host-fleet/tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p apps/deeptail/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.validate: bun run lint && bun run check:tree && bun run check:outdated && bun run check:cargo && bun run lint:ox && bun run check:styles && bun run check:bans && bun run check:entries && bun run check:registry && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run knip && bun run lint:rust && bun run test:rust && bun run test:browser && bun run a11y
